title: Request a demo | Alai Labs
description: Request a demo from Alai Labs, or reach our offices in Singapore, the United States and India.

head.p_1: Tell us about your site and what you want to fix. We will set up a demo of the robots, sensors or edge AI that fit.

request_a_demo.li_1: We read your request and reply by email.
request_a_demo.li_2: We agree a time and the site or problem to focus on.
request_a_demo.li_3: We show the products or a deployment that fits.
request_a_demo.p_1: Reply time and who handles requests to be confirmed by the Alai team.
request_a_demo.p_5: Our offices in Singapore, the United States and India
